svg.aria-label: A terminal where an agent reads AGENTS.md, the context file for Armin Zou
svg.text: agent — ~/arminzou — 80×43
● List ~/arminzou
● Read AGENTS.md
Context for agents working with Armin Zou. Read before substantial work.
This file covers one human. If he says something different in the
session, he wins.
Software engineer. Thinks in two languages, debugs in whichever one
swears better.
- Gluing things together that weren't made to fit, and making sure
the glue holds.
- Replacing old systems so quietly nobody notices the day it happens.
- Asking "why" until a vague request turns into a design.
- Handing work to coding agents and getting back something he'd
actually merge.
- Writing the instructions agents follow. You're reading some of them.
- Lead with why. He'll ask anyway.
- Commands should paste and run.
- Show something small that works before a long plan.
- No emojis unless asked.
- Never push without his go-ahead.
Two cats live here, too. Do not try to fix this.
● Got it. He overrides this file, wants the why first, and only takes
back work he'd merge. I'll leave the cats alone.
